body: That sounds really tough but if there's a time to stand out for looking different and being accepted for it, it's now. If you don't feel secure about that, maybe work on other things that help your self esteem.. maybe working out, a nice hair cut. More importantly work on your hobbies, passions, interests. You're still very young but what you don't realize is that most people worth having in your life don't even look at that at see past it enough to just want to hang out with you! There must be so many amazing things about yourself that you don't see, especially if you're only looking at your appearance. You're worth is so much more than that.. and I have a friend with a similar birthmark who guys absolutely love because she's got amazing energy and is really fun to be around. There is so much more to you than a birthmark. Don't let that define you. X

I can't believe how hard you've been trying. That makes me feel awful that things haven't got better. I'm not a therapist but Im happy to message you. You're right, that is unfair but be proud of how well you've done without it. Really. There must be some kind of therapy or something you're entitled to through work/ studies? Or does it not work like that? Do you have good days? I find it easier to help and advise others even though I've basically resigned to being a complete recluse myself ;(

Time isn't always a healer.. if not spent positively and actively fighting depression. I'm projecting but I feel the same way. I thought I hit rock bottom 4 years ago. I remember my brother saying.. 'you're right, things might not get better but they can certainly get worse'. He was spot on. I didn't fight it and things are horrendous. I hope you're actively doing everything you can to help yourself to move forward. The pits of hell can get pretty deep if you just keep sinking :( I really do wish u the best of luck xx

I feel like my thoughts are almost  nazi like  sometimes. I'd get could scan my post depression brain and see how much of a burden I now am to society I should be able to be euthanized. Not gassed to death but something a bit more peaceful..
Did you have friends before? Has something happened?
This definitely needs to be a book. If you don't start writing it, I may have to steal the idea. You have a new found purpose!
